tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The one material. Page ground AND the face of every raised card, button and rail: neumorphic parts are the same colour as the ground and read only through shadow-raised-*.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inside inset wells: inputs, slider tracks, switch tracks, summary panels, selected nav items. Always paired with shadow-inset-*.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Small parts that sit ON a well and must catch light: slider thumbs, switch thumb, the selected segment.

tokens.name: shadow-dark
tokens.usage: Lower-right shadow colour of the single top-left light. Reference only; use the shadow tokens.

tokens.name: shadow-light
tokens.usage: Upper-left highlight of the single top-left light. Reference only; use the shadow tokens.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body, field values, icons. 7.8:1 on surface, 7.2:1 on surface-sunken, 8.4:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, hints, captions, inactive icons. 5.4:1 on surface, 5.0:1 on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative marks only (≈2:1) — never for content someone must read.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside cards and table rows; decorative.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Underline rule under display headings, unselected radio/checkbox ring, focus-free control edge. 3.4:1 on surface.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: The only 'accent': filled primary pill, selected radio dot, slider fill, active indicators. A fill, not a text colour on surface (4.3:1).

tokens.name: graphite-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of graphite fills.

tokens.name: on-graphite
tokens.usage: Text and icons on graphite fills. 5.1:1.

tokens.name: graphite-soft
tokens.usage: Neutral badge and avatar fill; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset. Shadows can't carry focus in a one-material UI, so it is an outline.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive deltas, success icons. 4.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge / alert-icon fill.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text on success-soft. 5.8:1.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icons. 4.8:1 on surface.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge / alert-icon fill.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warning-soft. 6.2:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, negative deltas, destructive menu items. 5.1:1 on surface.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger badge / alert-icon fill.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on danger-soft. 6.0:1.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs, with a 6px backdrop blur. Light scrim: the room stays bright.

styles.name: display-light
styles.usage: Second line of a stacked heading, under heading-1 or an eyebrow.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Figures in stat tiles and balances. Light weight, tabular.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section heading; may be uppercase with the line-strong rule under it.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Soft surfaces, one light, quiet type.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, segment gutter.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to field, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon to label, menu item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field inner padding, field-to-field.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Bento gap, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (minimum — shadows need room).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Generous card padding, section gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between bento groups; page gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, menu items, tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rail icon buttons, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inset summary panels, textareas, alerts, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and bento cells.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, dialogs, the login card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges, segmented control, rails.

shadow.note: One light, from the top-left. Raised = dark lower-right + white upper-left. Inset = the same pair inverted. Never mix directions.

tokens.name: shadow-raised-xs
tokens.usage: Thumbs, selected segment, avatar ring.

tokens.name: shadow-raised-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, alerts.

tokens.name: shadow-raised-md
tokens.usage: Cards, bento cells, rails, tables.

tokens.name: shadow-raised-lg
tokens.usage: Hero cards, dialogs, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, radio and checkbox wells.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tracks, pressed buttons, selected nav.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-md
tokens.usage: Inset panels (cart summary), icon wells.

tokens.name: shadow-graphite
tokens.usage: Graphite filled pills — still lit by the same light.
